title: Tidal will ban fully AI-generated music starting December 9 and says such content accounted for ~43% of tracks distributed to its platform over the past 90 days (Ethan Millman/The Hollywood Reporter)
summary: Ethan Millman / The Hollywood Reporter: Tidal will ban fully AI-generated music starting December 9 and says such content accounted for ~43% of tracks distributed to its platform over the past 90 days — The service said Tuesday that more than 60 percent of new tracks uploaded to its service on Nov. 6 were fully AI-generated songs.
